a3: HighRows' obtain closed over the CoreSlacks hypothesis; replaced by explicit projections
a5: the aggregate doc block was missing its closing -/
a6: the Audit module still named the pre-rename bd_sub_k_le_wX

axioms.observed: 13/13 records report exactly the standard three
